model: Recreation-Cost-Anchored Seller Pricing with Engineering-Equivalent Rebuild Calibration

confidence.replacementCost: Primary seller-side build-versus-buy reference. It estimates the cost to independently recreate comparable present work product; it is not a certified cost audit or guaranteed buyer saving.
confidence.marketComparableProxy: Secondary buyer-side context. Sector-informed analytical proxy; direct subject-asset comparability is not established.
confidence.incomeLicensingProxy: Secondary buyer-side context. Analytical monetization proxy; buyer-specific cash flow and royalty evidence is not established.
confidence.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Secondary buyer-side context modelled using maturity, commercialization, rights and time-risk assumptions.
confidence.triangulatedEconomicReference: Secondary preliminary analytical reference rather than the primary seller pricing basis.

rebuildCostCalibration.approach: Current work-product scope plus incremental engineering-equivalent effort for materially expanded assets.
rebuildCostCalibration.rounding: Asset-level changes are rounded conservatively; unchanged assets retain their prior recreation-cost basis.
rebuildCostCalibration.boundary: Only reproducible software, research-software, validation, governance, packaging and handover work product is costed. Future productization, hosting, market execution and speculative scientific or commercial outcomes are excluded.

definitions.replacementCost: Primary seller-side build-versus-buy reference: estimated cost to recreate comparable present work product. It is not a guaranteed buyer saving or certified independent cost study.
definitions.marketComparableProxy: Secondary modelled marketability indication using maturity, potential and sector context; not a verified precedent-transaction valuation.
definitions.incomeLicensingProxy: Secondary modelled monetization indication; not a DCF or relief-from-royalty valuation and not seller-delivered future income.
definitions.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Secondary buyer-side opportunity reference anchored to replacement cost and adjusted for technical completion, commercialization probability, rights-transfer reserve, time/risk and sector context.
definitions.triangulatedEconomicReference: Secondary weighted analytical reference combining the four economic lenses; not the primary asking-price basis and not certified market value.
definitions.sellerAsk: Indicative seller-side source-code/IP acquisition asking reference positioned primarily against recreation cost. It is independently set rather than mechanically calculated from future income or enterprise value.
